content: #1 Probably the topic says it all: Is there a way how to convert nLab pages into a PDF, where all the links to other parts of the same site are retained, while external links don‘t need to be clickable. For context, I am trying to effectively download some of the lecture notes that are stored on the page.
subject: Convert nLab page to PDF with clickable links

content:
#2 Yes: Ask your browser to print the webpage, and then choose the option “print to file” or “print to pdf”.

That’s how, for instance, I created the pdf files at Introduction to Stable Homotopy Theory. (This was using Firefox and/or Iceweasel, but I suppose this works with most browsers.)
subject: Convert nLab page to PDF with clickable links
